title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith, remastered by Monte Barry (some flaws remain) MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx  One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro > TLH > CD Tag
source: Source: taped by Monte Barry, Sony TC 2850SD portable stereo cassette recorder, Sony ECM 99 single-point stereo mic, mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up, FOB center infield, between sbd platform and stage platform;

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience tape with crystal‑clear sound captures a sweet, spine‑tingling performance highlighted by a soaring China Doll and volcanic Sunshine Daydream.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give the recording five stars, praising its exceptional audio fidelity – some even call it their favorite Dead tape. The show is described as sweet and spine‑tingling, with the first set edging out the second, though both feature standout moments like a beautiful China Doll and an explosive Sunshine Daydream. Overall the performance and the capture are deemed superb.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews highlight both a top‑tier performance and an outstanding recording, giving strong confidence in a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners rave about the tape’s clarity, warmth, and overall fidelity, calling it possibly their favorite Dead recording; no flaws or dropouts are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is considered the stronger of the two, but the second set remains compelling with smooth transitions and high energy, ending on a volcanic Sunshine Daydream.
